requirement.subjectNotes: Include 6 in Physics or either HL Mathematics route. An exceptional SL route uses SL Mathematics Analysis and Approaches or SL Physics at 7 with HL 6/6/6. SL Mathematics Applications and Interpretations is not accepted unless Physics is also studied.
requirement.conditions: The IBCP and eligible stand-alone HL certificates can be considered individually with equivalent study to at least three A levels. For IBCP, Visual Art and Mathematics or Physics are normally required, with at least one at HL and appropriate vocational study. Stand-alone IB certificates typically require Visual Art and either Mathematics or Physics at HL.
